text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! That super-duper tough gum Bubble 
gave me? I crushed it to bits in ten 
seconds flat!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm glad to see you liked the 
birthday present. That gum tasted pretty 
good, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Could it be that Windy was spitting 
it out before it got tasty?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That gum gets tastier the longer you chew 
it, but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What?!?! S-So that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that has nothing to do with it! 
I-It's not like I'm interested in softened 
gum anyway!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not like... I care how it 
tastes, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Cheer up, Windy. At times like this, 
sweet treats are the way to go."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? W-Wait, isn't this THAT gum?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now that you mention it, that's true. 
Hey, since we're at it, want to see who 
can chew the longest?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan accepts your challenge! I'm 
gonna make you regret ever challenging 
me—!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha, go easy on me, alright?
